logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Flat technical illustration for a fleet-charger decision brief: a single linear-scale vertical bar chart of measured energy per acceptance batch for four charger packages — P2 15 kWh, P3 24 kWh, P1 44 kWh, P4 64 kWh — every bar labeled with its exact table value on one consistent axis from 0 to 70 kWh, all bars the same color, no rescaling. A slim side panel lists quality margins (+20/+15/+11/+8), spare defect slots (2/4/2/0) and energy-per-quality ratios (0.16/0.26/0.44/0.73). The lowest bar is annotated as the minimum-energy selection, and a small dashed annotation marks the next-lowest qualifier as the conditional re-verification alternate. Clean corporate style, muted blue-gray palette, no 3D, no extra legend text.
